projects.name: Renaissance Substation 138 kV second FPL interconnection
projects.description: HPS plans a second 138 kV transmission path from FPL at the Renaissance Substation, looping FPL's Florida City-Princeton 138 kV line, so Homestead no longer depends on a single interconnection at Lucy. Engineering (E.C. Fennell, $330,008) awarded Aug 2026; construction window estimated after design.

sources.title: Homestead Reviews Infrastructure, Utility and Budget Items (Aug 21, 2026)
sources.quote: Homestead's electric system currently relies heavily on a single 138-kilovolt interconnection at the Lucy Switching Station to receive power from FPL

projects.name: McIntosh-Purrysburg 230 kV reactors and rebuilds
projects.description: Install reactors on the McIntosh-Purrysburg 230 kV tie lines and rebuild the short Georgia Power sections at McIntosh. The sponsor challenge reference supplies the June 2026 target and the McIntosh coordinate, but does not resolve Purrysburg; this record therefore locates only the known McIntosh endpoint as an approximate Point and does not claim a complete route. The construction window is inferred and is not a published schedule.
